mithapukur.source: Sentinel-1 RTC, ESA/Copernicus via Planetary Computer
mithapukur.caveat: Threshold-detected open water, not measured flood depth. Native 10 m sampling has approximately 20 x 22 m SAR resolution; tiny plots and vegetation limit flood detection. Otsu can separate non-water land covers.

method.median_filter: 3x3 in linear gamma0, one-pixel read halo
method.otsu_support: entire buffered context; first maximum between-class variance
method.sampling: nearest native 10 m samples on a common UTM45N grid
method.field_fraction: water pixel centers inside traced polygon / all field pixel centers
method.orbit_selection: all 12 months, then minimum sum of seconds from each 15th 00:00 UTC; orbit number breaks ties
